description:
The **AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata** runbook helps you configure Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) options for your Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instances. Using this runbook, you can configure the following:
> * Enforce the use of IMDSv2 for instance metadata.
> * Configure the `HttpPutResponseHopLimit` value.
> * Allow or deny instance metadata access.

For information about instance metadata, see [Configure the instance metadata options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/configuring-instance-metadata-options.html) and [Transition to using Instance Metadata Service Version 2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-metadata-transition-to-version-2.html).
### Important:

You should proceed cautiously and conduct careful testing before making any changes to IMDS. Take note of the following:

> * If you enforce the use of IMDSv2, applications or agents that use IMDSv1 for instance metadata access will break.
> * If you turn off all access to instance metadata, applications or agents that rely on instance metadata access to function will break.
> * For IMDSv2, you must use `/latest/api/token` when retrieving the token.

InstanceId.description: (Required) The ID of the Amazon EC2 Instance you want to configure metadata options.

HttpPutResponseHopLimit.description: (Optional) The desired HTTP PUT response hop limit value (`1-64`) for instance metadata requests. This value controls the number of hops the PUT response can traverse. Recommended value for HttpPutResponseHopLimit is `1` which prevents the response from traveling outside of the instance. Specify `0` to keep the current value. Default is `0`.

EnforceIMDSv2.description: (Optional) Enforce IMDSv2. If you choose `required`, IMDSv2 will be enforced. If you choose `optional`, both IMDSv1 and IMDSv2 will be enabled for metadata access (IMDSv2 won't be required). If you enforce IMDSv2 (`required`), the applications that use IMDSv1 might not function correctly. Before enforcing IMDSv2, make sure your applications that uses IMDS are upgraded to a version that support IMDSv2. Default is `optional`. Specify `unchanged` to keep the current value instead of applying the default.

MetadataAccess.description: (Optional) Allow or deny instance metadata access in the Amazon EC2 instance. If you specify 'disabled', all other parameters will be ignored and the metadata access will be denied for the instance. Default is 'enabled'. Specify `unchanged` to keep the current value instead of applying the default. If the current value is `disabled`, `unchanged` also ignores all other parameters.

AutomationAssumeRole.description: (Optional) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) role that allows Systems Manager Automation to perform the actions on your behalf. If no role is specified, Systems Manager Automation uses the permissions of the user that starts this runbook.

mainSteps.name: getCurrentMetadataOptions
mainSteps.description: Gets the current IMDS options of the instance and resolves the `HttpTokens` and `HttpEndpoint` values to apply. `unchanged` resolves to the current value.

inputs.Script:
# Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. All Rights Reserved.

import sys
from typing import Dict, Optional, Union

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

sys.tracebacklimit = 0

UNCHANGED = "unchanged"


def script_handler(events: Dict[str, str], _: object) -> Dict[str, Optional[Union[str, int]]]:
    """
    Gets the current IMDS options of the instance and resolves the values to apply.

    For EnforceIMDSv2 and MetadataAccess, `unchanged` resolves to the current value.

    Args:
        events (dict): InstanceId, EnforceIMDSv2 and MetadataAccess input parameters
        _ (object): Unused context parameter

    Returns:
        dict: Initial IMDS options and the HttpTokens and HttpEndpoint values to apply

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: If the instance can't be described
        ValueError: If the response doesn't contain the IMDS options
    """
    instance_id = events["InstanceId"]
    ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")
    try:
        response = ec2.describe_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
    except ClientError as error:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to describe instance {instance_id}: {error}") from None

    try:
        metadata_options = response["Reservations"][0]["Instances"][0]["MetadataOptions"]
    except (KeyError, IndexError):
        raise ValueError(f"IMDS options not found for instance {instance_id}") from None

    current_http_tokens = metadata_options.get("HttpTokens")
    current_http_endpoint = metadata_options.get("HttpEndpoint")

    target_http_tokens = events["EnforceIMDSv2"]
    if target_http_tokens == UNCHANGED:
        target_http_tokens = current_http_tokens

    target_http_endpoint = events["MetadataAccess"]
    if target_http_endpoint == UNCHANGED:
        target_http_endpoint = current_http_endpoint

    return {
        "InitialState": metadata_options.get("State"),
        "InitialIMDSv2": current_http_tokens,
        "InitialMetadataAccess": current_http_endpoint,
        "InitialHttpPutResponseHopLimit": metadata_options.get("HttpPutResponseHopLimit"),
        "TargetHttpTokens": target_http_tokens,
        "TargetHttpEndpoint": target_http_endpoint,
    }

mainSteps.description: Branches the automation based on the value of `MetadataAccess` input parameter.

mainSteps.name: branchOnHttpPutResponseHopLimit
mainSteps.description: Branches the automation based on the value of the `HttpPutResponseHopLimit` parameter.

mainSteps.name: maintainHopLimitAndConfigureImdsVersion
mainSteps.description: Maintains the current hop limit (`HttpPutResponseHopLimit`) and configures the Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) enforcement option.

mainSteps.name: waitBeforeAssertingIMDSv2State
mainSteps.description: Waits 30 seconds before asserting the Instance Metadata Service V2 (IMDSv2) status.

mainSteps.name: setHopLimitAndConfigureImdsVersion
mainSteps.description: Calls the `ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions` API to configure `HttpPutResponseHopLimit`, `HttpTokens`, and `HttpEndpoint` EC2 instance attributes.

mainSteps.name: castHttpPutResponseHopLimit
mainSteps.description: Casts the value of `HttpPutResponseHopLimit` input parameter to `String`.

mainSteps.name: waitBeforeAssertingHopLimit
mainSteps.description: Waits `30 seconds` before asserting the IMDS options.

mainSteps.name: assertHopLimit
mainSteps.description: Asserts the `HttpPutResponseHopLimit` property is set to the value you specified.

mainSteps.name: branchOnIMDSv2Option
mainSteps.description: Branches verification based on the value of the `EnforceIMDSv2` input parameter.

mainSteps.description: Waits `30 seconds` before checking IMDS endpoint state.

mainSteps.description: Asserts IMDS endpoint access is disabled.

mainSteps.description: Describes current IMDS options for the instance.
